# Hello, Welcome to My GitHub! 👋

## About me

My name is Felipe, I'm a **Research Fellow at the Polytechnic Institute of Bragança (IPB), Portugal**. I hold a Master's degree in Informatics from a dual-degree program between IPB and the **Federal Technological University of Paraná (UTFPR), Brazil**, which shaped my international experience and technical foundation across diverse environments.

I am a Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence researcher with a strong focus on applied ML systems and MLOps. My current work is focused on heAICare, a project that applies AI to fetal-neonatal neurodevelopment research.

I have developed robust skills in **Python**, **Scikit-Learn**, **PyTorch**, and other data science libraries, allowing me to work on data-driven solutions and explore AI-driven innovations. I'm always looking forward to connecting and contributing to meaningful data-centric projects.

- 🔭 **Current Project:** heAICare (AI for fetal-neonatal neurodevelopment)
- 🌱 **Learning:** MLOps, Applied Research, 3D reconstruction pipelines
